name: chain-challenge-signed-bytes

graded_by.test: vault/challenge_test.go — TestChallengeSignedBytesVector: reproduces the published vector using the core implementation or independent Go test code for a browser-only step
harness/rigs/vault-vectors.sh — rig-vault-vectors: runs this vector through the deployed browser module in Chromium and requires every selected case to pass

description: The device challenge's signed bytes (device-trust, the challenge): the label, then the challenge, the user, device_id, the login handle and the operation, each length-prefixed (vault.schema.json x-associated-data device_challenge), and one P1363 signature that verifies over them and not over the same challenge built for part2.regenerate. ECDSA signing is randomised, so this fixes the bytes and a verification, never a signature an implementation must reproduce.

implementations.what: the browser builds the bytes and signs them (WebCrypto ECDSA P-256, SHA-256)
the Go core builds the bytes from its own record and verifies
